summary.text: Sandy Salmon is a Republican Iowa state senator who has represented District 29 since 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A farm owner and home educator, she previously served in the Iowa House of Representatives from 2013 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Sandy Salmon was born in Lawton, Oklahoma, graduated from Kingsley-Pierson High School in 1973, and earned a bachelor's degree in business management from the University of Northern Iowa in 1977.
She served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 1977 to 1980.

Her career experience includes owning a farm and working as a home educator, and she has been affiliated with the Marine Corps League, Bremer County Corn Growers and Black Hawk County Republican Women.
Salmon represented District 63 in the Iowa House of Representatives from 2013 to 2023 and has served in the Iowa State Senate since January 3, 2023.
She advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.
